HANSEN PROTECTION AS (org.nr 871 200 092) is registered as Aksjeselskap (AS), founded 1994-10-26, registered 1995-03-12. Business address: Tykkemyr 27, 1597 MOSS. Main industry (NACE): 14.290 Produksjon av klær og tilbehør ikke nevnt annet sted. Registered employees: 127 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 372,627,107; operating result NOK 12,986,339; net result NOK 413,033,266; total assets NOK 1,230,299,698; equity NOK 1,052,540,125. Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Thomas Patrick Linkenheil; board chair Thomas Patrick Linkenheil; 3 other board members. Sub-units registered: 3. Website: www.hansenprotection.no. The website describes the company as: "Trusted premium personal protection equipment, including immersion suits and lifejackets. We deliver reliable gear designed for the toughest environments where failure is not an option." LEI: 549300O2S8AQL7PEXU36 (ACTIVE).
